displayName: Foundry projects should have an Application Insights connection
description: Audit Foundry projects without a project-level AppInsights connection with a nonempty target. Foundry connects Application Insights per project for tracing. An account-level connection, diagnostic setting, or unrelated Application Insights resource does not satisfy this check. Does not verify target existence, telemetry delivery, or instrumentation.

builtInReview.gap: No Foundry connection-presence audit was found among 2862 live built-ins. Diagnostic-settings and private-link policies do not establish AppInsights integration. The project connection category and target aliases were verified in the live Cognitive Services provider.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists reports a missing related connection without changing the project. Deny cannot implement this related-resource existence check.
